class.name: RemoteControlRegistry
class.brief_description: Registry of remote control commands exposed over HTTP and to scripts.
class.description: Engine singleton that stores named commands as callables. Built-in commands are registered when [RemoteControlServer] starts. Projects can add custom commands with [method register_command]. Commands are invoked via [code]POST /v1/exec[/code] with body [code]{ "command": "name", "args": {} }[/code] or through [method execute].

method.name: execute
method.description: Executes a registered command and returns its result dictionary.

method.name: list_commands
method.description: Returns an array of command metadata dictionaries ([code]name[/code], [code]description[/code], [code]schema[/code]).

method.name: register_builtins
method.description: Registers the built-in remote control command set.

method.name: register_command
method.description: Registers a command. The callable receives a single [Dictionary] of args and should return a [Dictionary] result.
